selection_policy: mean_r@1 descending, validation_loss ascending, earliest epoch
source: feat/omnirad-clip-pipeline (K8 windowed CLIP, gradient replay, timm-format towers); ran 2026-10-05 from the t3code-5f0dc525 worktree's then-uncommitted copy of that code via the gitignored arms.sh/chain.sh, translated here. The series mirror comes from paths.json (train_series_mirror).
purpose: Change one factor of the DINOv2-small codec reference recipe per arm (LoRA r64/a128 on the last 6 blocks of both towers, lr 1e-4/1e-4/1e-3, batch 32, 20 epochs, seed 2026). Judged by frozen-tower LM MLP heads, each against the unadapted tower at the same input. --contrastive-microbatch-size is gradient replay: gradient-equivalent to plain batch 32, a memory measure only.
lm_head_command: python scripts/train_lm_head.py --config configs/kaggle/<head>.json --features checkpoints/kaggle/<head>-features.npz --output checkpoints/kaggle/<head> --device cuda
